extraction_notes.visit_pattern: 1 screening visit (pre-operative clinic), 1 treatment visit (day of surgery).
assumptions: Screening and consent are assumed to occur during the standard pre-operative clinic visit as per protocol preference.
The day of surgery (Day 0) is counted as the primary treatment contact day and is included in the 1_month window.

Post-operative assessments on Days 1-3 are conducted in-person only if the patient remains hospitalized; however, since many surgeries are outpatient and the protocol allows for phone follow-up, only the surgery day is counted as a mandatory in-person contact day.
All follow-up assessments at 1 month, 6 months, and 1 year are conducted via phone, mail, or online (REDCap) and do not require in-person contact.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Every 3 weeks for the entire duration for drug administration (Trastuzumab infusions).

Every visit involves either drug administration or dispensing, thus categorized as core_treatment.

After cycle 6, Day 1 visits are categorized as imaging_diagnostics if restaging occurs, or labs otherwise, as Sorafenib is oral and self-administered.
Patient is assumed to remain on treatment for the full 12-month period for the purpose of this calculation.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: 4 cycles of anthracycline (q3w), followed by a 3-week gap, then 18 cycles of HER2-targeted therapy (q3w). Arm 1 includes weekly taxane (Paclitaxel) during the first 4 HER2 cycles.
assumptions: Assumed 4 cycles of anthracycline chemotherapy (q3w) prior to HER2 therapy.
Assumed a 21-day gap between the last anthracycline dose and the first HER2-targeted dose.
Used Paclitaxel (weekly) for Arm 1 calculation as it represents the maximum healthcare contact frequency for this arm.
Screening is assumed to be completed in 1 unique calendar day.
The 12-month window (Day 365) includes up to Cycle 14 Day 1 of the HER2-targeted phase.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Leukapheresis (1 day), Conditioning (3 days), Infusion + Observation (8 days), then follow-up assessments at Day 50, 100, 150, M9, M12.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: 2-3 cycles of chemotherapy (3 days/cycle), Stem Cell Collection (~6 days), HDT/ASCT hospitalization (~21 days), then follow-up assessments.
assumptions: Assumed R-ICE regimen (3 days per cycle) and a total of 3 cycles.
Stem cell collection estimated at 6 days (G-CSF + apheresis).
HDT/ASCT hospitalization estimated at 21 days (standard for autologous transplant).
Day 50 assessment is counted as a standalone imaging visit post-transplant.
Follow-up assessments (Day 100, 150, M9, M12) are counted as imaging days.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Chemotherapy: Day 1 of each 21-day cycle (assumed 8 cycles). Endocrine: Every 3 months for the first year.

Screening requires 3 separate days for initial consult (Step 1), labs, and extensive imaging (Step 2).
Endocrine follow-up visits occur every 3 months in the first year.
Annual mammogram occurs at the 12-month visit.
Chemotherapy visits include labs and physicals, assigned to core_treatment priority.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Endocrine therapy: Every 3 months for the first year.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Clinic visit for IV infusion every 14 days (Day 1 of each cycle).
assumptions: Screening is estimated at 2 days (one for labs/consent/biopsy review, one for baseline imaging/ECG/ECHO).
Treatment phase labs, physical exams, and imaging are assumed to occur on the same day as the scheduled infusion.
Follow-up visits (FU1 and FU2) occur after treatment discontinuation and are not included in the 12-month treatment window count.
Survival follow-up is excluded as it can be performed via telephone.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Clinic visit for drug dispensing and monitoring every 14 days (Day 1 of each cycle).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Chemotherapy every 21 days (6 cycles); GnRHa every 28 days starting 1-2 weeks pre-chemo; Follow-up every 3 months post-chemotherapy.
assumptions: Assumed a standard 6-cycle chemotherapy regimen (e.g., TEC or FEC) every 21 days.
GnRHa injections (goserelin/leuprorelin) occur every 28 days, with the first dose in the screening window and subsequent doses continuing until ~8 weeks post-chemo.
Screening includes one day for labs/exams and one separate day for the first GnRHa injection.
Follow-up visits (every 3 months post-chemo) include transvaginal ultrasound and blood draws, categorized as imaging_diagnostics.
Adjuvant endocrine therapy for HR+ patients is assumed to be oral and does not add clinic contact days unless GnRHa is resumed (which is conditional and excluded from base count).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: 5 consecutive days of chemotherapy every 28 days for 6 cycles.
assumptions: Screening is estimated at 2 days to accommodate comprehensive staging including neuroimaging, lumbar puncture, labs, and physical exam.
Each chemotherapy cycle (block) involves 5 consecutive days of in-person contact for infusions (Days 1-5).
Cycle 2 Day 1 and Day 2 fall within the 1-month (30-day) window (Cycle 1 Day 1 = Day 1, Cycle 2 Day 1 = Day 29).
Response evaluations (primarily imaging/diagnostics) are conducted after Block 2 and Block 6, each counted as 1 additional contact day.
Radiotherapy for patients >3 years old is mentioned but not included in the count as a specific daily schedule is not provided in the 'Return Visits' summary.
No specific follow-up visit schedule is provided after the end of treatment (Week 24-26).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Day 1 of each 21-day cycle for chemotherapy infusion.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Nivolumab 3 mg/kg every 2 weeks for 3 doses; Ipilimumab 1 mg/kg on Cycle 1 Day 1 only.

Survival follow-up visits are counted as imaging days due to scheduled CT scans every 12 weeks.
Optional adjuvant therapy is excluded from the primary count.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Platinum-doublet chemotherapy every 3 weeks for 3 cycles; assumed Day 1 and Day 8 visits per cycle for regimens like Gemcitabine or Vinorelbine.
assumptions: Screening is estimated at 2 days.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Nivolumab 360 mg flat dose every 3 weeks + platinum-doublet chemotherapy for 3 cycles; assumed Day 1 and Day 8 visits per cycle.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Daily RT for 7 weeks (5 days/week); Nivolumab Q2W for 8 doses, then Q4W (every 28 days).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Daily RT for 7 weeks (5 days/week); Maintenance TMZ 6 cycles (28-day cycles) with clinic visits on Day 1 and Day 22 for labs.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Day 1 of each 3-week cycle (Q3W).
assumptions: Screening is counted as 1 unique calendar day for Visit 1 assessments.
On-study imaging (Q9W) aligns perfectly with treatment visits (Cycles 4, 7, 10, 13, 16) and is categorized under core_treatment due to priority.
Subject remains on treatment for the full 12-month observation period.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Day 1 of each 2-week cycle (Q2W).

Subject remains on treatment for the full 12-month observation period.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycle 1-2: Days 1, 8, 15; Cycle 3+: Day 1 only.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Weekly visits (Days 1, 8, 15) throughout treatment based on mandatory weekly lab requirements.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Days 1-7 (Azacitidine admin), Day 8 (Labs - C1 only), Day 15 (Imaging/Labs - C1-4 only), Day 22 (Labs - C1 only).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Days 1-7 (Azacitidine admin), Day 8 (Labs - C1 only), Day 15 (Imaging/Labs - C1-4 only), Day 22 (Labs - C1 only).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Monthly for the first 4 months (M1, M2, M3, M4), then every 3 months (M7, M10, M13).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Monthly for the first 4 months (M1, M2, M3, M4), then every 3 months (M7, M10, M13).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Daily RT for 6 weeks (30 days); Nivolumab Q2W for 8 doses then Q4W; Maintenance TMZ 28-day cycles with lab visits on Day 1 and Day 22.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Daily RT for 6 weeks (30 days); Placebo Q2W for 8 doses then Q4W; Maintenance TMZ 28-day cycles with lab visits on Day 1 and Day 22.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycle 1: Day 1 infusion. Cycle 2+: Pre-dose lab visit (<=5 days prior) and Day 1 infusion visit.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycle 1: Day 1 infusion. Cycle 2+: Pre-dose lab visit (<=5 days prior) and Day 1 infusion visit.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Daily Radiotherapy (RT) for 36-39 fractions (assumed 37 for calculation), 5 days per week.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: LHRH injection on Day 1; Pre-RT labs at Day 46; Daily RT (5 days/week) starting Day 60 for ~37 fractions.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycle 1: Days 1, 8, 15; Cycles 2-6: Day 1; Cycle 7 and thereafter: Day 1 every 6 weeks (every 2 cycles).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycle 1: Day 1 and Day 15. Subsequent cycles: Day 1 of every 28-day cycle.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycles 1-6: Days 1, 2, 15; Cycles 7-12: Day 1; Cycles 13+: Day 1 every 8 weeks.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Days 1, 4, 8, 11 for RVD cycles (C1-C8); Maintenance visits weekly for 2 months, biweekly for 2 months, then monthly.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycle 1: Days 0, 1, 2. Cycles 2-6: Days 1, 2. Post-treatment: Day 1 every 3 cycles.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycle 1 Week 1: 4 days (training/treatment); Weeks 2-6: 2 days/week (treatment); Week 8: 1 day (assessment). Cycles 2 & 3: 2 days/week (treatment) for 6 weeks; 1 day (assessment) at end of cycle. Follow-up: 1 day every 4 weeks.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: 1 screening visit, 1 surgery visit (Day 1), and 1 routine post-operative follow-up visit (approx. 2-3 weeks post-surgery).

Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROMs) at 3 and 6 months are collected remotely via an electronic portal as specified in the protocol text, and thus do not count as healthcare contact days.
Day 1 is categorized as core_treatment due to the surgical procedure and drug administration taking priority over intraoperative imaging.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Daily radiation therapy (5 fractions per week) for 37 fractions total over approximately 7.4 weeks.
assumptions: Screening includes 1 day for imaging (CT/MRI/Bone scan) and 2 days for clinic visits/labs/biospecimens based on varying assessment windows.

Follow-up visits occur at 6 and 12 months from the start of radiation therapy.
End of Treatment (EOT) assessments occur on the final day of radiation therapy and are counted within core_treatment days.
Androgen Deprivation Therapy (ADT) is optional and its administration is assumed to coincide with other scheduled visits or is not counted as a mandatory protocol-defined contact day.
